summary: Focused frontend propagation test after site.js config update (phone + VK). All four phone elements (header-phone-link, mobile-phone-link, contacts-phone-link, footer-phone-link) display '+7 (993) 100-06-03' with href='tel:+79931000603'. Both VK links (contacts-vk, footer-vk) point to https://vk.ru/tutpc with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. TG/Avito remain '#'. Backend regression smoke: POST /api/leads => 201, GET /api/leads with admin token => 200.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadForm.jsx line 209 still uses literal '+7 (___) ___-__-__' as an <input placeholder> attribute. This is the ONLY remaining occurrence of that string in the DOM. It is a legitimate input-hint placeholder (not a rendered phone display) and should NOT be replaced with the real number (that would auto-fill the field visually). Consider making the placeholder look distinct, e.g. '+7 (900) 000-00-00', if the client wants zero occurrences of the exact old string. Otherwise leave as-is — this is expected UX.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_regress lead created via POST /api/leads during smoke test.
